CTE_1_actor_works.SELECT: p.name_id, AVG(t.average_rating) AS actor_avg_rating, COUNT(*) AS actor_movie_count

CTE_2_director_works.SELECT: p.name_id, AVG(t.average_rating) AS director_avg_rating, COUNT(*) AS director_movie_count

MAIN_QUERY.SELECT: n.primary_name, a.actor_movie_count, ROUND(a.actor_avg_rating, 2) AS actor_avg_rating, d.director_movie_count, ROUND(d.director_avg_rating, 2) AS director_avg_rating
